record.title: Validate the integrated thread-aware two-read observer with private controls
record.intent: Combine discovery, continuous worker execution, clone reporting and precise mapped-state observation.
requirements: Reuse bounded thread discovery and release all covered threads normally before modeled execution.
Private controls must require a sibling acknowledgement and create a newly traced worker before the mapped reads.
Permit only two guarded main-thread read responses at offsets 0x4048 and 0x4044 with the established synthetic words.
Positive control stops immediately after composed-value storage using the proven hardware breakpoint profile.
Negative controls stop on an unexpected second offset and an unsupported worker mapped access without another response.
Account for runtime thread events and terminal pending stops; quiesce and inventory the group before exact cleanup.
Unknown signals, identities, instructions, accesses or exhausted bounds produce a recorded negative result.
acceptance: Independent verification proves sibling progress, new-thread attribution, guarded response counts, terminal state and complete group cleanup.
Preserve guest enforcement and system_server stability; no stock application run in private controls.
Commit and push the control conclusion before stock execution.
